name: libero_spatial_residual_env_v0
notes_path: Path A locked: algorithm main path = LIBERO pure sim. ReBot assets frozen — do NOT modify ReBot contract/overlay/gate as primary.
notes_backend: DRAFT pending full libero install. Pip package libero==0.1.1 pulls torch/CUDA/robosuite/wandb/transformers (heavy). Smoke uses faithful interface stub mirroring OffScreenRenderEnv API (check_success, action_dim=7). Real path: scripts/attempt_libero_real_env.py + MUJOCO_GL=egl.
notes_task: Smoke picks libero_spatial task_id=0 (canonical first Spatial suite task). Replace only via contract bump; do not invent task names at runtime.
notes_obs_dim: Actor smoke obs = concat([proprio(8), a_base(7), phase(1)]) = 16. Images NOT in Actor. proprio ≠ q/qdot (ReBot); a_base matches demo action dim 7 (relative EE+gripper), NOT mirrored as second proprio.
notes_action_unit: LIBERO/robosuite OSC relative EE: Box(-1,1)^7 = [dx,dy,dz, dax,day,daz, gripper]. Units are controller-normalized relative EE deltas + gripper (NOT joint rad, NOT ReBot clip_c=0.03 rad). Dummy/no-op often [0,0,0,0,0,0,-1]. chunk/a_base same 7-dim as LeRobot demo actions.
notes_proprio: Locked VLA observation.state = eef_pos(3)+axis_angle(3)+gripper(2)=8. Built from LIBERO native robot0_eef_pos / quat→axis_angle / robot0_gripper_qpos. Do NOT invent aliases.
notes_clip_c: Independent of ReBot joint ±0.03 rad. Residual δ = clip(actor_out,-1,1)*clip_c in the SAME normalized relative-EE action space as demos (dimensionless controller scale). Applied uniformly to all 7 dims for v0 smoke; bump reward_version/clip notes if per-dim bounds land later.
notes_control_hz: Locked at 20 Hz = robosuite/LIBERO native control_freq. Residual δ applies only on control steps. Dataset fps labels sometimes say 10 — that is NOT this gate's control_hz (see OpenTau/LeRobot corrections → 20). Do not silently mix.
notes_sim_dt: robosuite default often timestep 0.002 with control_freq 20 → 25 substeps. Stub records these for parity; real OffScreenRenderEnv owns physics timing.

notes_reward_success: reward_version=libero_v0_sparse_success_plus_delta_l2: r=-λ‖δ‖² + 1{success_just_now}·R_term with λ=0.01, R_term=+1.0. NO extra shaping. Success = env.check_success() ONLY (authoritative LIBERO BDDL). Do NOT invent z_lift / held_steps geometry. terminated=success; timeout → truncated + failure_mode=timeout.
notes_failure_mode: failure_mode ∈ {none, timeout, unsafe}. timeout=truncated by t_max; unsafe=NaN/Inf in proprio/a_exec (minimal); else none while running/on success. No 'drop' (that is ReBot cube-lift privilege).
